statusLegend.beta: in the current release; one release-gate item still open (the real-iPad run)

features.name: Ekza Studio and Ekza Studio Pro
features.description: One studio with two layouts over the same document and undo history: the touch-first Simple layout (the front door) and the docked, hotkey-driven Pro layout.

features.name: Start chooser
features.description: A first visit opens Ekza Studio; /?chooser=1 lists Ekza Studio, Ekza Studio Pro and Rig a model for me; the choice can be remembered.

features.name: One document, three shells
features.description: Switch between the two layouts and Auto-Rig on the same page with the same document, undo history, selection, time and camera.

features.name: Model, Animate, Rig & Skin workspaces
features.description: Task-focused tabs with docked, rearrangeable panels.

features.name: Layout presets and focus mode
features.description: Animate, Blocking, Polish and Review layouts on Alt+1-4, user presets, viewport-only focus, full screen.

features.name: Industry-standard DCC hotkeys and marking menus
features.description: Industry-standard DCC hotkeys, radial marking menus and three navigation profiles (mouse, trackpad, one-button).

features.name: Command palette
features.description: Find and run any command by name (Mod+K).

features.name: Split and quad viewports
features.description: Single, shot + free camera split, or four views with W/E/R manipulators in object, world or gimbal space.

features.name: Review workspace
features.description: Dedicated review tab.

features.name: Primitives and templates
features.description: Cube, sphere, cylinder, cone, plane, torus; prop, handheld and humanoid templates; reference image planes.

features.name: Component editing
features.description: Vertex, edge and face modes with loop and ring selection, grow/shrink, convert and soft selection.

features.name: Box-modeling tools
features.description: Adjustable extrude session, inset, bevel, bridge, insert/offset edge loop, multi-cut, slide, merge and target weld.

features.name: Symmetry, snapping, pivots
features.description: Per-mesh symmetry for every tool, grid/vertex/increment snapping, pivot editing.

features.name: Palette colour
features.description: Colour per face from a palette, exported as a palette texture, vertex colours or one material per colour.

features.name: Poly Count HUD and Mesh Check
features.description: Triangle budgets per asset type and game-readiness checks.

features.name: Make editable
features.description: Edit an imported character's mesh and bake it back with skin weights and expressions.

features.name: UV editor, subdivision, booleans, sculpting
features.description: Advanced modeling and texturing tools.

features.name: Quick Rig markers
features.description: Nine markers guessed from the silhouette, dragged in front and side views, with a live VRM skeleton preview.

features.name: VRM skeleton templates
features.description: Lite 17, Core 21, Standard 33 and Full 52 humanoid skeletons with an automatic control rig.

features.name: Joint fitting
features.description: Move, rotate, orient, mirror and map joints with symmetry.

features.name: One-click Bind Skin
features.description: Automatic low-poly skin weights computed in a worker.

features.name: Weight painting
features.description: Replace, Add, Scale, Smooth and Flood with mirrored strokes, holds and test poses.

features.name: Straighten to T-Pose
features.description: An A-posed model becomes a T-pose VRM rest in one step.

features.name: Validation gate
features.description: Checks with one-click fixes that gate the VRM export.

features.name: Constraints and control-shape editing
features.description: Parent/point/orient/aim constraints, props, sockets and custom control shapes.

features.name: Five-step wizard
features.description: Model, Markers, Rig, Animations, Export: from a static humanoid GLB to an animated VRM in minutes.

features.name: Model checks with fixes
features.description: Centred, grounded, facing, upright, human size and pose, each with a one-click fix.

features.name: Multi-part characters
features.description: Detects which parts belong to the body; separate parts can move rigidly.

features.name: One-click Auto-rig
features.description: Skeleton, skin and T-pose straightening in one press, then adjust joints or paint weights.

features.name: Animation library
features.description: 14 CC0 clips with preview, speed, trim, mirror, in place and arm space; your own VRMA too.

features.name: Ready-for-OMOBA export
features.description: VRM 1.0 behind a checklist with OMOBA's runtime rules, plus GLB, VRMA and an OMOBA local test kit.

features.name: Phone and tablet layouts
features.description: Works on tablets; on phones everything except weight painting.

features.name: Automatic control rig
features.description: Circle controls on any skinned GLB or VRM, sized from the mesh.

features.name: Leg and arm IK
features.description: Two-bone IK with poles, soft IK, foot roll, IK/FK blend, match and seamless switch.

features.name: Keying, breakdowns and tweens
features.description: Hotkey keying (S, Shift+W/E/R), auto-key, breakdown keys and the tween family with overshoot.

features.name: Dope Sheet and time slider
features.description: Retime with ripple edit, copy, scale, insert/remove time and key nudge.

features.name: Graph Editor
features.description: Weighted/stepped tangent model (AnimX-compatible), weighted handles, buffer curves, normalized/stacked views, Euler filter, Simplify.

features.name: Clips and poses
features.description: Several clips per character with slots and tags; copy, paste and mirror poses; mirror animation by half a cycle.

features.name: Onion skin and motion trails
features.description: Visual arc and spacing aids.

features.name: Animation layers
features.description: Layered animation editing.

features.name: Lambert and Blinn shaders
features.description: Every palette swatch is a shader, assigned to faces or objects, exported as glTF PBR.

features.name: glTF and VRM import
features.description: GLB, VRM 0.x and 1.0, VRMA clips and Ekza projects, by drag and drop.

features.name: Lossless bake into the original file
features.description: Clips written back into the GLB/VRM with every original value and byte preserved.

features.name: VRMA and animation GLB export
features.description: One clip per VRMA file or animation-only GLB, with error-bounded key reduction.

features.name: VRM 1.0 character export
features.description: Avatar with meta, licence and thumbnail, checked against OMOBA's runtime rules.

features.name: Export profiles and lints
features.description: Ekza, OMOBA, Bevy and generic profiles with read-back checks.

features.name: Animation-only GLB import
features.description: Add clips from an animation-only GLB by node name.

features.name: FBX and BVH import (incl. common auto-rigger skeletons)
features.description: Import and retarget from common animation formats.

features.name: Projects
features.description: Ekza project files that embed the source models.

features.name: Autosave and recovery
features.description: Autosave in the browser with crash recovery.

features.name: Gesture-level undo
features.description: One gesture is one undo step everywhere.

features.name: Real-time collaboration
features.description: Live sessions with presence; the document model is already collaboration-ready.

features.name: Ekza Space and OMOBA ready
features.description: One VRM 1.0 file works as an avatar in Ekza Space and OMOBA.

features.name: Publish to Ekza Hub
features.description: One-click avatar publishing to Ekza Hub.

features.name: Game targets (character contract)
features.description: Bind a character to a game's contract (OMOBA's bundled): every slot with its status, timing, game defaults and fixes.

features.name: OMOBA hero package
features.description: VRM 1.0 with your animations and ekza_package_v1, byte lints, timeline markers and a developer zip.

features.name: MCP server and live bridge
features.description: AI agents such as Claude Code connect to the open editor with a pairing code and granted permissions.

features.name: Undoable AI edits
features.description: Every agent action is one labelled undo step; revert all AI changes in one click.

features.name: Rig and animate by prompt
features.description: An agent can inspect, fix, rig, add library clips and export a character.

features.name: Agent sees the scene
features.description: View captures and contact sheets from the user's or preset cameras.

features.name: Halo verbs
features.description: Touch anything and up to six plain verbs appear next to it; More lists every operator with its Pro name.

features.name: Search or ask
features.description: Every operator by name, recipes (Wave, Loop it, Rig it for me, Fix where it bends badly) and Ask AI.

features.name: Path and readiness
features.description: Make, Paint, Rig, Animate and Share; one list of checks behind the glyphs, the status count and the Next chip.

features.name: Pencil and fingers
features.description: The Pencil makes, fingers move the view; the Thumb key carries every modifier; palm rejection; Reduce gestures.

features.name: Animate by touch
features.description: Timeline in frames with a tick on every frame, Rec on by default, the Animations row, Keys, Curves, Reach posing, the Library and History.

features.name: Make, Paint and Rig by touch
features.description: Clean-up for a game in two touches, swatches with Matte or Shiny, Rig it for me on one card, dots in front and side panes, weights with Pencil pressure.

features.name: Home, Share and resume
features.description: Continue cards, samples, byte-sniffed files, destination-first Share byte-equal to Pro, Save project to Files, silent resume after a reload.

features.name: Clean-up operators
features.description: Clean up for a game in one undo step: reduce to a budget without cracking seams, normalize, palette bake, downsize textures. Local, no provider.

features.name: Generation gateway
features.description: Self-hosted gateway with adapters for two text/image-to-3D services, a token and spend caps; off by default. Tested against mock providers.

features.name: Generate panel and Create with AI
features.description: Words or a photo, size presets, terms, plan and price, jobs, Bring it in cleaned, then Rig it.

features.name: AI disclosure
features.description: The generator is recorded in exports and shown as a Made with AI badge.

features.name: Runs in the browser
features.description: Chrome and Edge; Ekza Studio also on Safari 26+ on iPad (beta). No install.

features.name: Private by design
features.description: Files never leave the browser; no telemetry. AI generation only through a gateway you configure, only when you press Create.

features.name: Open source
features.description: MIT licence.

features.name: Firefox, and Pro on Safari
features.description: Support for more browsers.
